description_compelling: Material change to how a country recruits, deploys, or controls its armed forces — conscription reform, defense-spending shifts, command restructuring, civil-military rebalancing. Government-effectiveness scores, judicial-constraint measures, and political-stability indices typically reposition first. Frequent in states with assertive militaries renegotiating their political role.

trajectory_alignment.method: z-aggregated across the emitted positive cases (count in samples_used), aligned by lead-year, gaps linearly interpolated. Pre-§F walks emit head(5) positives; §F-onward emit the full corpus.
